definition: Latest-source net EPS, retaining basic/diluted basis, restated only for reviewed ordinary share-count changes through the frozen vendor price snapshot date. No cash dividends, spin-off valuation factors, or business-scope restatements. Not point-in-time data and not permission to calculate P/E from Adjusted Close.
source_basis_policy: For these exact frozen selected EPS sources, actions after the source filing date remain to be applied. Sources on or after each action already incorporate it. This is a reviewed snapshot approval, not an automatic rule for new filings. Pre-split pro-forma tables in AFL, APH and CTAS are not the selected reported EPS. Predecessor issuers share the current issuer's share basis only through the reviewed one-for-one share_exchanges of each company, so their filings receive the same later actions.
